title: 국립중앙도서관과 그 소속 도서관 이용규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00496:20221208:00003:part:1/1

ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Libraries Act) <No. 496, December 8, 2022>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on December 8, 2022.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) Omitted.

(2) The Rules on the Use of the National Library of Korea and Its Affiliated Libraries are partially amended as follows:

In Article 2, "subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Libraries Act" shall be replaced with "subparagraph 2 of Article 3 of the Libraries Act".

(3) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
